components.name: Chart/Crosshair
components.description: Follows the pointer on hover (Web) or a long-press drag (Mobile/Tablet) and snaps to the nearest data point. Vertical = time series, Both = scatter / bubble. Value tags use fill/inverse + text/inverse. Pair with Chart/Tooltip. React: <ChartCrosshair axes="x|xy" />
